No clear understanding of the problem
No explanation of what happened, why it happened, or how to handle it
No meaningful guidance or responsibility shown

Your own words made it clear that you didn’t want to take the risk, and that’s exactly why I refused that condition because you weren’t ready to stand by your duty as a doctor.

You talk about honesty and accuse others of false allegations, but we are not even personally known to each other. I have no reason to hold grudges.
